title: H102G corn (Bioseed H102G): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: H102G corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: H102G corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon. About 106 days to harvest, 10.7 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: H102G corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Bioseed H102G or H102. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2019 as NSIC 2019 GMCn 66. Bioseed Research bred it. It takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 10.7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Bioseed H102G or H102, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

H102G corn takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 10.7 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 106 in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 15.3 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 82.2 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
What its seller and farm sources say

**Traits in the seed:** Bag carries VT Double PRO (caterpillar protection) and Roundup Ready Corn 2 (glyphosate tolerance) marks.
**Where:** Luzon.
Made for dense planting, about 80,000 plants/ha.
Even ears, filled from base to tip.
Shelling recovery above 82 percent.

Registry rates it resistant to lodging and corn borer.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: second highest yield (7.99 t/ha) and second highest net income at Central Luzon's first corn derby in Mexico, Pampanga. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant H102G corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Bioseed H102G the same as H102G?
items.a: Yes. Bioseed H102G is another name for H102G, registered as NSIC 2019 GMCn 66. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 10.7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Luzon. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of H102G?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
